placements.why: The organization shifts its analytics platform choice from Zypherion to Meridian to resolve streaming ingestion limitations, establishing native support for both batch and streaming queries under the existing Q3 2026 migration schedule and superseding the previous columnar-only adoption narrative.
placements.title: Transitioning analytics pipeline to Meridian for native batch and streaming ingestion
placements.frame: How does the analytics infrastructure evolve to support unified batch and streaming workloads with Meridian?
